avis.texte: I have normal, 40 year old, type 1 rosacea skin and this is my favorite clay mask for summer! I don't use clay masks as often now that I'm older and my skin is dryer, but about 2-3 times a month really keeps my pores cleaned out and my skin tight. This smells like mint ice cream without the sweetness and is SUPER cooling. After a hot sweaty day or if I'm having a flush, this feels amazing. Be careful if you are sensitive as this doesn't just have peppermint leaf in it but it also has peppermint oil, which can be irritating for people with sensitive skin. But my skin doesn't mind it and this mask is perfect for me!
Such a good quality mask, it feels so yummy and minty. Leaves my face feeling refreshed and clean. I like to add water and exfoliate a little as in rinsing off in circular motions. 😍

I recently tried I Dew Care's Chill Mo-Mint Soothing Wash-Off Mask, and it's a delightful treat! Inspired by mint chocolate chip ice cream, this mask not only smells amazing but also delivers a refreshing, cooling sensation. **What I Loved:** - **Cooling Effect:** The peppermint extract offers an instant, soothing coolness that my skin really appreciated. - **Hydration:** My skin felt well-hydrated and replenished after use. - **Great Scent:** The mint chocolate chip scent adds a fun, indulgent touch to the experience. **Key Ingredients:** - **Peppermint Extract:** Provides a soothing and revitalizing cooling effect. - **Aloe Vera Extract:** Moisturizes and softens the skin. - **Glacier Water:** Helps keep skin hydrated and fresh. **How I Used It:** I applied a generous layer to my clean face, avoiding the eyes and lips. After 5-10 minutes, I rinsed it off, and my skin felt refreshed and smooth. Overall, the Chill Mo-Mint mask is a fun and effective addition to my skincare routine. It's perfect for a quick pamper session or when my skin needs a little extra care. If you're looking for a soothing mask with a playful twist, this one is a must-try!
